about_the_game:
MUST FIND BEANS is a fast-paced first-person shooter centered around your desperate search for beans. As you’re approaching the end of cooking breakfast, you realize you’re all out, and without them, the day just won’t start off right.

Many will try to stop you as you race out in search of the final piece of your feast. But you must not let them. Find some beans by any means necessary before everything else you left cooking burns.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains depictions of cartoon violence within the context of a fictionalised setting.
